Hillary Baker

Director of Operations

After 14 years in year nonprofit marketing and communications, Hillary joined her husband Dustin to establish Henkels & Baker, PC, in 2018. While she spends most of her time behind the scenes leading administrative operations, she also works directly with clients on student loan adversary cases. Hillary is passionate about hiring excellent people, investing in technology and implementing strong processes to create the best client experience possible.
